title: refactor: make ModelInfo the catalog contract
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Document every detailed model-list response with `ModelInfoSchema`
- Reuse one list schema across model categories
- Derive the dashboard catalog type from `Partial<ModelInfo>`
- Fix the documented `output_modalities` field name

Tests: Gen and Enter typechecks; OpenAPI, catalog, and pricing tests

gist.headline: One catalog, fewer ghosts
gist.blurb: The model catalog stopped carrying several nearly identical maps of the same garden. Dashboard and API docs now grow from the same ModelInfo seed.
gist.summary: Standardized detailed model-list responses on ModelInfoSchema, reused one schema across model categories, derived the dashboard catalog from Partial<ModelInfo>, and corrected the documented output_modalities field name.
gist.impact: Developers and dashboard users get a more consistent model catalog, with API documentation and frontend model metadata describing the same fields.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends a single well-labeled model catalog plant whose branches feed both a retro API terminal and a dashboard CRT, representing one shared ModelInfo contract. Small signs on the branches read "API", "Dashboard", and "output_modalities", with the monitor robot happily comparing matching catalog cards.
